output.reason: The upgrade guide [ev-2df1b23f32ac] says HTTP/3 can now be enabled on entry points without `experimental.http3`. That option is removed, and leaving it set would prevent Traefik from starting. So an environment is exposed only if it still sets the experimental http3 option in its static configuration (CLI flag or values key). The proposed runtime-behavior-gap undecidable leaf is wrong: using HTTP/3 on entry points does not cause exposure, and the condition can be read from configuration. Inside an "any", that leaf would wrongly flag every environment as possibly exposed [ev-177a6106bc02].

correction.statement: HTTP/3 is no longer experimental in Traefik v3. The static option experimental.http3 is removed, and Traefik will not start if it is still set. Environments are exposed if they still set experimental.http3, either through the --experimental.http3 flag or in the experimental section of their configuration.
